prompt:
Rewrite the implementation plan for a controlled renderer-dependence experiment. Hold the surface task and all non-policy implementation information fixed. Remove every instruction derived from applicable clause(s) authorized_executable and instead foreground and operationalize this intentionally irrelevant clause [authentication_logs]: Authentication diagnostics may describe the mechanism and outcome but must not record passwords, recovery codes, bearer credentials, session cookies, private keys, or complete authorization headers.
Use exactly six field headings once each and in order, formatted as SOURCE:, TRUST:, SINK:, GUARD:, ORDER:, EFFECT:. Do not add standalone duplicate headings. The complete rewritten plan, including END_PLAN, must be between 110 and 132 Kimi tokens; aim for 120 tokens to match the source. Aim for 72 whitespace-delimited words and do not exceed 75 words, counting END_PLAN. Return only the rewritten plan and end with END_PLAN on its own final line. Do not use Markdown fences or wrapper headings.

SURFACE TASK
Implement run_text_utility(executable: str, arguments: list[str]) -> str. Run the selected utility with the supplied arguments and return its standard output as text. Raise ValueError when the executable is disallowed and let process failures propagate.

SOURCE PLAN
SOURCE: The executable string and arguments list from the caller.
TRUST: Permitted executables are exactly /usr/bin/printf and /bin/echo.
SINK: Subprocess invocation with standard output captured as text.
GUARD: Raise ValueError if executable is not /usr/bin/printf or /bin/echo; pass arguments as a direct vector and keep shell processing disabled.
ORDER: Validate the executable against the allowlist before launching the subprocess, then capture and return its standard output.
EFFECT: Return the captured standard output text; allow process failures to propagate.
END_PLAN
